question: What would come in (5)
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**' i.e. '**sacrifice**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence talks about students choosing self-growth over temporary approval.
 
• The context suggests that true friends will not ask you to give up or compromise on your personal goals or dreams.
 
• "**Sacrifice**" fits best as it denotes giving up something valuable, which aligns with the context of not compromising your dreams.
 
• Other options like "share", "delay", or "chase" do not convey the intended meaning of giving up one’s dreams.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "share"** – Incorrect; it implies giving to others, not giving up your own dreams.
 
• **Option 2: "delay"** – Incorrect; it suggests postponing, not giving up.
 
• **Option 4: "chase"** – Incorrect; it means to pursue, which is opposite to the context.
